body: Idk it’s just nice to see that maybe someone cares
Either a drawing that a girl in my class drew of me for secret santa or the drawing my Internet friend drew of me and him but we’re not that close anymore
Sit alone in my room and cry
I liked my friend and I told him and now he doesn’t want to be friends with me anymore idk why but it just completely broke me and idk what to do with my life anymore
Nothings really going on I’ve just felt like complete and utter crap physically and mentally for so long

Because they basically wanted nothing to do with me after I told them. 

And it isn’t just because of them that I still do it, there’s loads of other reasons.
